segments.he: טְמֵאִין מִדְרָס, וְאֵין יוֹצְאִין בָּהֶן בְּשַׁבָּת, וְאֵין נִכְנָסִין בָּהֶן לָעֲזָרָה.
segments.en: It was taught in the mishna that the supports of a zav and his chair «are» subject to «ritual impurity» imparted by «treading, and one may not go out with them on Shabbat, and one may not enter into the» Temple «courtyard with them.»
